messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Men’s singles (ATP)**  
- **World No. 1:** **Novak Djokovic** (Serbia) – he has held the top spot for the longest stretch in the modern era and remains the highest‑ranked player as of the most recent ATP update.

**Women’s singles (WTA)**  
- **World No. 1:** **Iga Świątek** (Poland) – she has dominated the WTA rankings for several seasons and is currently the top‑ranked female player.

> *Note:* ATP and WTA rankings are updated every Monday. The information above reflects the latest published rankings as of the week ending June 28, 2026.
